from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,importlib.util,zipfile
r=Path.cwd();s=r/'.local/step07-r7-zip-fix';f=s/'final';w=r/json.loads((f/'workspace.json').read_text())['workspace'];source='c8d41a680df42fe565882d93d3f85a04f7a10b22';sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=w,text=True).strip()==source
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=w)==b''
ms=list((w/'artifacts').glob('step07-*/manifest.json')); assert len(ms)==1;mp=ms[0];b=mp.read_bytes();m=json.loads(b);assert m['commit']==source
files=[]
for n,h in m['files'].items():
 a=(mp.parent/n).read_bytes(); live=(w/n).read_bytes();assert a==live and sha(a)==h,n;files.append({'path':n,'sha256':h,'bytes':len(a)})
assert len(files)==206
old=r/'artifacts/step07-59423201ba10-191301abe69ac02e/manifest.json';om=json.loads(old.read_text());delta=[n for n in m['files']if m['files'][n]!=om['files'][n]];assert delta==['apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json'],delta
meta=json.loads((mp.parent/delta[0]).read_text());assert meta['context']['commit']==source
oldmeta=json.loads((r/delta[0]).read_text()); adjusted=json.loads(json.dumps(meta)); adjusted['context']['commit']=oldmeta['context']['commit']; assert adjusted==oldmeta,'unexpected production resource metadata change'
(s/'engineering-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':source,'buildId':m['buildId'],'manifestPath':str(mp.relative_to(r)),'manifestSHA256':sha(b),'manifestBytes':len(b),'count':len(files),'allImmutableAndLiveHashesMatch':True,'old594LivePayloadDelta':delta,'onlyStudioSourceMetadataChanged':True,'files':files},indent=2)+'\n')
# Use the exact independently authored R7 oracle, not the TS reader's implementation.
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('r7_independent',s/'r7-original/probes/verify-zips.py');mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
rows=[]
for p in sorted((w/'.local/step07/tests').glob('*/normal-wire-download-*.zip')):
 v=mod.verify(p);assert v['source']==source
 with zipfile.ZipFile(p)as z:assert z.testzip() is None
 rows.append({'origin':str(p.relative_to(r)),'result':'NORMAL_ACTUAL_WIRE_ACCEPTED','independentTwoDirectoryOracle':v,'pythonZipfileCRC':True})
assert len(rows)==4,len(rows)
for p in sorted((w/'.local/step07/tests').glob('*/diagnostic-download-*-central-crc.zip')):
 try:mod.verify(p);raise AssertionError('bad archive accepted')
 except AssertionError as e:assert str(e)=='Local/central CRC disagree',str(e)
 with zipfile.ZipFile(p)as z:
  badMember=z.testzip();assert badMember=='A1.png','testzip must identify corrupt member'
  try:z.read(badMember);raise AssertionError('stdlib read accepted bad CRC')
  except zipfile.BadZipFile:pass
 rows.append({'origin':str(p.relative_to(r)),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'result':'CORRECTLY_REJECTED_NEGATIVE_NOT_ARTIFACT_PASS','independentError':'Local/central CRC disagree'})
assert len(rows)==5,len(rows)
(s/'latest-independent-wire-oracles.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':source,'oracleOrigin':'exact R7 verify-zips.py','oracleSHA256':sha((s/'r7-original/probes/verify-zips.py').read_bytes()),'normalActualWire':4,'actualFaultedWireRejected':1,'rows':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'buildId':m['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(b),'payloads':len(files),'normalActualWire':4,'negativeRejected':1}))
